steps.clue: Restore power and unlock Pack-a-Punch at Checkpoint Charlie.
Activate Klaus and obtain the CRBR-S.
Use Klaus and the CRBR-S Blazer to open the Secret Lab.
Charge the three canisters with Tempest essence and return them to the Conversion Unit.
Use Klaus to stop the train.
Recover the Warhead and Rico’s Keycard, then activate the Disruptor Satellite.
Defeat the HVT Megaton and use its uranium to craft two Uranium Devices.
Collide the Uranium Devices on the rooftop zipline, then repeat the process to charge the Warhead.
Defeat Valentina and defend Klaus as he carries the Warhead into the portal.
